setup: CREATE TABLE n AS SELECT i, i::UBIGINT AS u, (i/100.0)::DECIMAL(12,2) AS d FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: unsigned_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT u FROM n WHERE u%2=0

workloads.name: decimal_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM n WHERE d>=250.00

workloads.name: decimal_grouped_cents
workloads.sql: SELECT (u%128)::BIGINT,(sum(d)*100)::BIGINT FROM n GROUP BY u%128

workloads.name: decimal_equality_join
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM n a JOIN n b ON a.d=b.d

workloads.name: decimal_window_cents
workloads.sql: SELECT (sum(d) OVER (PARTITION BY u%128)*100)::BIGINT FROM n
